statements.t: Our preliminary, unaudited Q3’26 revenue is $11.0 million, up 38% from Q3’25, beating our guidance of $9 million to $10 million.

Our total drone, defense and industrial pipeline grew 18% to approximately $216 million; the drone pipeline alone grew 48% to approximately $150 million and is expected to continue to grow through 2027.
We will report the first accomplishments of our cost reduction plan in our Q3’26 report on November 12.”
Q3’26 Guidance is as provided by the Company on August 12, 2026.
2 GAAP figures are preliminary; the Company’s Q3’26 GAAP financial statements will be included in its Form 10-Q.
Final reconciliations for the third quarter of 2026 are expected to be included in the Company's earnings release on or about November 12, 2026.
